title: Vegan Friendly Energizing Middle Eastern Oyster Mushroom Muhammara
description: A flavorful and energizing vegan-friendly middle eastern dish featuring oyster mushrooms as the base, topped with a creamy score-fat sauce and a crunchy finishing touch.
instructions: Rinse the oyster mushrooms and pat them dry with a paper towel.
Place the mushrooms on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the oven for 10 minutes.
While the mushrooms are roasting, mix the roasted red pepper, pomegranate molasses, lime juice, smoked paprika, garlic, and chopped parsley in a bowl.
Once the mushrooms are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool for a minute.
In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the mushrooms until they are coated in the oil and fragrant.
Mix the score-fat sauce with the roasted red pepper mixture and pour it over the mushrooms.
Serve immediately and garnish with additional parsley if desired.
